mentions.name: Web data aggregation REST API
mentions.description: This REST API aggregates and structures data from the web, with a vanilla Python ETL pipeline orchestrated by Cron and SIGUSR1, served through Nginx, uvicorn, and FastAPI, and storing data in a CAFS store indexed with Xapian with a ~200ms load time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
building a rest APIs that aggregates and structures data from the www

- ETL is vanilla Python
- Orchestrated with Cron and SIGUSR1
- http is Nginx -> uvicorn-> FastAPI
